title: Stablecoin payment = FX operation
message: Brazil treats international payments with stablecoins as FX operations (Res. BCB 521, amending Res. 277): purpose code and counterparty data are required.

title: USD 100k cap per operation (standard VASP)
message: Res. BCB 521 caps an international payment with virtual assets at USD 100k per transaction for VASPs (SPSAVs) when the counterparty isn't authorized in the FX market.

title: eFX providers can't settle in stablecoins
message: Since Oct 1, 2026, eFX providers may not use virtual assets to settle with their foreign counterparties (Res. BCB 561, art. 50). Use an authorized VASP or a bank.

title: Off-ramp authorization still pending
message: Off-ramp's BCB authorization is pending. Incumbent VASPs had to file by Oct 30, 2026 (Res. BCB 520, art. 88); from Nov 6, 2026 Brazilian banks and payment institutions may not deal with unauthorized VASPs (Res. BCB 589).

title: Unauthorized VASPs excluded (pack policy)
message: Off-ramp is not BCB-authorized. Oct 30, 2026 is the filing deadline for incumbent VASPs (Res. BCB 520, art. 88); this pack stops routing to unauthorized VASPs from that date, ahead of the Nov 6 bank cut-off (Res. BCB 589).

title: Banks may not operate with crypto
message: Mexican banks may not offer clients crypto exchange, transmission or custody (Banxico Circular 4/2019, in force Mar 9, 2019; reaffirmed by the CNBV in May 2026). Use a licensed non-bank off-ramp.

title: Ramps must be registered PSAVs
message: Virtual-asset service providers must be registered with the CNV (RG 994/2024, in force Mar 25, 2024). Argentine banks still can't offer crypto (BCRA Com. A 7506). Use a registered PSAV.

title: Official vs. parallel FX gap
message: Official and parallel ARS rates differ by more than 5%. Confirm the rate with the payee.

title: Venezuela sanctions program
message: Hard stop: Venezuela sanctions. Requires a named OFAC general license and compliance sign-off.
